TARS Explorer 1.4.0 - COVAS event setup

KEEP KNOWN ON, REACT OFF for exploration events:
FSDJump
Location (if exposed)
CarrierJump
FSSDiscoveryScan
DiscoveryScan
Scan
FSSBodySignals
FSSBiologicalSignals (if exposed)
FSSAllBodiesFound
SAAScanComplete
SAASignalsFound
ScanOrganic
ScanOrganicFarEnough (if exposed)
ScanOrganicFirst (if exposed)
ScanOrganicSecond (if exposed)
ScanOrganicThird (if exposed)
CodexEntry
ApproachBody
LeaveBody

Do NOT enable raw Scan/FSS/biology Reacts to make Explorer talk. Explorer dispatches TARSExplorerTarget itself at meaningful milestones.

IMPORTANT FOR EXOBIOLOGY
------------------------
Some COVAS versions expose derived ScanOrganicFarEnough / ScanOrganicFirst /
ScanOrganicSecond / ScanOrganicThird reactions in addition to the raw ScanOrganic journal event.
Keep ALL of them at No react (known). If ScanOrganicThird is set to React,
COVAS can announce the completed sample and Explorer will then correctly emit
TARSExplorerTarget for the same completion, producing two spoken lines.

Use No react (known), not Hidden, so TARS retains the event as conversation context.
